verdict.rationale: Cubic ships a built-in AI chat/assistant experience where users can delegate tasks — asking chat to 'tour this PR', adding code to AI chat for contextual Q&A, requesting one-click fixes ('Fix with cubic') that get generated and pushed automatically, and interacting via PR comments to trigger reviews or fixes. This is a genuine in-product assistant, not just an external agent integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation specifically of the chat-delegation UX (community evidence only covers review-comment quality, not the assistant/chat delegation flow), and no detail on task-completion reliability or scope limits of delegated tasks.
